heading: Hi, I'm Budi.
intro:
I’m a photographer currently focused on everyday photography. Focusing on this genre gives me the flexibility to keep my shooting and editing skills developing without sacrificing my daily work commitments. I love documenting places, friend and moment that meaningful to me. 

Having taken a long hiatus from photography, I’m now using this space as my playground to practice and reconnect with the medium.
quote: Almost everything happened before the shutter.
